title: Identify Metaphase
hook: See how chromosomes change during the cell cycle.

doesNotKnow: The events associated with stages of the eukaryotic cell cycle.

misconception: DNA replication and chromosome separation happen at the same time.
objective: Connect an event with its cell-cycle stage.

claims.text: Which cell-cycle stage is most associated with this event: Duplicated chromosomes align at the cell equator. Metaphase: Duplicated chromosomes align at the cell equator. Stages are a useful description of a continuous process.
